title: DeviaDecisionRegister
description: The decisions a project owes an explicit answer to. A missing answer is a recorded state, never an empty space for the next agent to fill in (DEC-001).

decisions.description: Slot key -> decision. The key names the decision (`brand.logo`, `stack.framework`); its first segment is the group, which is what the context router routes on.

status.description: Four, not three: `not_required` is a ruling ('this product ships no photography'), and folding it into `pending` would leave a permanent false alarm on a project that has already answered.

question.description: What this slot asks, in the words a reader needs.

value.description: The ruling. Required when status is `decided`, unless the ruling is the file named by `path`.

because.description: Why. Required by `decided` and `not_required` — a ruling nobody can review is folklore.

owner.description: Who owes the answer. Required by `pending`: a question nobody owns is a question nobody will answer.

to.description: Who the choice was delegated to. Defaults to the agent.

bounded_by.description: The limits of the delegation. Required by `delegated` — delegation without bounds is absence wearing the word explicit (DEC-002).

path.description: The file this decision delivers, relative to the repository root. Checked to exist once the slot is decided (DEC-005).

package.description: The dependency this decision pins. Its major is compared with the manifest, never with a registry: devia has no network, and 'is this still the newest' is npm outdated's question (DEC-003).

blocks.description: Paths that must not exist while this slot is pending. This is the only thing that turns a pending decision into a P0 failure, and the project declares it — a gate that failed on every open question would be switched off inside a week.

decided_at.description: ISO date the ruling was made. Stamped by `devia decide`.
